Three clearly distinct friendly humanoid robots, each with two arms and two legs, distinct silhouettes, no humans. Moderate depth of field, environment and robots both readable. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, frames, split panels, collage, puzzle-piece lines or known franchise designs.
Scene: Three friendly mecha explorers on a moon's observatory terrace overlooking a spectacular ringed planet and tiny orbital stations. A cobalt-blue and ivory leader kneels to examine a glowing star-map orb, a short orange robot holds a navigation beacon, and a mint-green robot adjusts a small telescope. Ribbed metal decking, coiled cables, moon pebbles and translucent crystalline growths in the foreground; white research domes and mountain ridges in the middle distance. Rich indigo and teal with warm orange accents and violet rim light. A welcoming expedition scene with all three robots fully visible.
